equivalence.method: Ten fixed graphs, three clearance configurations and three consecutive in-place point perturbations. The loss, minimum radius and every gradient coordinate must match the original source with Object.is. Input and previously returned output ownership are checked too. Default/original and default/moved rows have 256 warmup calls and 48 calibration calls per implementation, recorded separately. Six alternating-order timed rounds use equal-sized batches estimated to take at least 20 ms in the faster implementation, bounded to 48–1024 calls. Times are milliseconds per call; comparisons, fixture construction and imports are outside timers. These are routine timings, not complete solver speed measurements.

pairedFits.method: Four fixed 200-pixel free-border inputs, three alternating-order pairs per input. Every fit runs in a fresh Node process. Both complete engine snapshots have identical dependencies and differ only in refine.js. Each timer includes prepare, solve, validation and export; imports, process startup, fixture generation and independent export replay are outside it. Every result must meet the existing 3% image and 10-second limits and retain geometry/paper checks. Each paired cut_geometry.json hash must match exactly.
pairedFits.harnessChangesAfterRun: Replaced an unused destructured binding with explicit metadata fields, and added harness hashing to future reports. Timed worker code and fixtures are unchanged.
